h:
我创建了这个工作流程作为文本到图像和图像到图像的实验室。它包括多个可简化操作之间切换的节点，以及一个 Lora 堆栈器，可对流程进行简化和精简的添加。我分享这个主要是为了在 Civtai 上记录它，以防万一有人发现它有用。

我提供了一个注释面板来解释如何开始。所有额外的节点都可以通过 ComfyUI Manager 下载，而且我相信升级器也可以直接从 ComfyUI Manager 界面访问。

如果您只是想制作图像并且对许多额外选项感到困惑，我尝试使标题和节点名称对于那些可能没有编程背景的人来说更加直观。我的目标是帮助您开始创作艺术，而不会感到不知所措或需要支付高额费用。

这个工作流程在我的笔记本电脑上运行顺利；但是，您的体验可能会有所不同。它允许使用 SD1.5 模型、SDXL 模型或基于 PONY 的模型生成图像。我目前正在使用与 Flux 一起运行的扩展版本，尽管目前该设置有点复杂。一旦感觉更精简且更容易让外人理解，我将使用该版本更新此工作流程。

我的 SD1.5 模型 HICCUP 可以替换为任何 SD1.5 模型，但我建议从这里下载 HICCUP，因为它是值得的。

o.en:
I created this workflow to serve as both a text-to-image and image-to-image laboratory. It includes several nodes that simplify switching between operations, as well as a Lora stacker that allows for streamlined and condensed additions to the flow. I’m sharing this primarily to keep a record of it here on Civtai, just in case someone finds it useful.

I've included a notes panel that explains how to get started. All the extra nodes can be downloaded through the ComfyUI Manager, and I believe the upscaler can also be accessed directly from the ComfyUI Manager interface.

If you're just trying to make images and feel confused by the many extra options, I've attempted to make the headers and node names more intuitive for those who may not have a programming background. My goal is to help you start creating art without feeling overwhelmed or needing to pay high fees.

This workflow runs smoothly on my laptop; however, your experience may vary. It allows for images to be generated using SD1.5 models, SDXL models, or PONY-based models. I’m currently using an extended version that operates with Flux, though that setup is a bit more complex at the moment. I’ll update this workflow with that version once it feels more streamlined and easier for outsiders to understand.

My SD1.5 model, HICCUP, can be replaced with any SD1.5 model, but I recommend downloading HICCUP from here because it’s worth it.
